sd_browser_open.tooltip: Open the SD-card directory at the given path and refresh the entry list

sd_browser_count.tooltip: Total number of entries in the current directory

sd_browser_is_dir.tooltip: Check whether the given entry is a folder

sd_browser_is_jpg.tooltip: Check whether the given entry is an image file (jpg/jpeg/bmp)

sd_browser_is_font.tooltip: Check whether the given entry is a font file (.bin)

sd_browser_name.tooltip: Get the file name of the given entry

sd_browser_path.tooltip: Get the full path of the given entry

sd_browser_up.tooltip: Go back to the parent directory and restore the selection

sd_browser_up_sel.tooltip: Entry index restored when going back to the parent directory

sd_browser_is_root.tooltip: Check whether the browser is currently at the root directory

sd_browser_show.tooltip: Draw the file list and highlight the given selection

sd_browser_load_font.tooltip: Load the reading font from the SD card

sd_browser_unload_font.tooltip: Unload the reading font and free memory

sd_browser_font_loaded.tooltip: Check whether the reading font is loaded

sd_browser_font_height.tooltip: Get the current font height in pixels

sd_browser_font_width.tooltip: Get the current font width in pixels

sd_browser_load_ui_font.tooltip: Load the UI font from the SD card

sd_browser_unload_ui_font.tooltip: Unload the UI font and free memory

sd_browser_ui_font_loaded.tooltip: Check whether the UI font is loaded (including shared reading font)

sd_browser_share_font.tooltip: Use the reading font as the UI font to save memory
